sources.issues: three cases from known_wrong.json, by issue number

cases.title: Missing freeze on fold: (urem X, -1) -> select(X == -1, 0, x)
[InstCombine] poison-generating attributes are not dropped when folding logical and/or of icmps
cases.ir:
define i1 @src(i32 noundef %Value) {
entry:
  %cmp.not = icmp eq i32 %Value, 0
  %0 = call range(i32 1, 33) i32 @llvm.ctpop.i32(i32 %Value)
  %cmp1 = icmp ult i32 %0, 2
  %1 = select i1 %cmp.not, i1 false, i1 %cmp1
  ret i1 %1
}

define i1 @tgt(i32 noundef %Value) {
entry:
  %0 = call range(i32 1, 33) i32 @llvm.ctpop.i32(i32 %Value)
  %1 = icmp eq i32 %0, 1
  ret i1 %1
}

cases.title: [InstCombine] `noundef` attribute should be dropped
